en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing the front façade of a large church with a rose window, classical columns and an ornate entrance portal, standing on an open square bordered by historic multi‑story buildings. A tall bell tower rises on the left side of the church, and mountains are visible in the background. Several people in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand in the square. The printed titles at the top read "TRENTO" on the left and "Chiesa di Santa Maria Maggiore" on the right.
